assessment.summary: Observed behavior deviates from the established baseline and warrants investigation.

claims.text: The observed process activity shows a significant deviation from the established behavioral baseline.
The observed activity may require security investigation because the deviation is associated with an unusual process pattern.

security_relationships.explanation: A substantial deviation from the established baseline can indicate behavior requiring further investigation.

alternative_explanations.explanation: The deviation may also result from a legitimate administrative or maintenance operation.

unknowns: The intent of the process cannot be established from the available telemetry alone.
recommendations: Review related authentication and system activity.

knowledge.title: Linux Behavioral Anomalies
knowledge.content: Significant deviations from an established behavioral baseline can warrant additional investigation.

limitations: The available telemetry does not establish the user's intent.
